name: MapRow - ResearchBand
description: A round that is mostly research gets its own territory rather than just its own card colour: a tinted ground behind the whole row, a hairline enclosing it, and the eyebrow WHAT ALREADY EXISTS in place of the round number. Because a row is already a round, this costs almost nothing — a good sign the round was the right seam to have cut. The gap card counts toward the band while still wearing the question colour, since it is a fact about what exists that nobody has an answer to.
